camel_example: aliyun eci CommitContainer --region cn-hangzhou --AcrRegistryInfo.InstanceId 'cri-nwj395hgf6f30000' --Arn.RoleType service --AcrRegistryInfo.ArnService 'acs:ram::1609982529000000:role/role-test' --Image.Tag '0.0.6' --AcrRegistryInfo.ArnUser 'acs:ram::1298452580000000:role/role-test' --Image.Repository 'registry-vpc.cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/test/test-0000' --Image.Author alice --AcrRegistryInfo.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ContainerName 'container-1' --Image.Message test_commit --ContainerGroupId 'eci-bp1do4xz75fa5sd0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Arn.RoleArn 'acs:ram:xxx' --method POST --force
description_en: Call the CommitContainer operation to create an asynchronous task that saves a specified container in an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instance as an image and pushes the image to an image repository in Alibaba Cloud Container Registry (ACR)
description_zh: 调用CommitContainer接口创建异步任务，将ECI实例中的指定容器保存为镜像，并推送至阿里云ACR的镜像仓库中
kebab_example: aliyun eci commit-container --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --container-group-id eci-bp1do4xz75fa5sd0000 --container-name container-1 --image Repository=registry-vpc.cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/test/test-0000 Message=test_commit Author=alice Tag=0.0.6 --acr-registry-info ArnService=acs:ram::1609982529000000:role/role-test InstanceId=cri-nwj395hgf6f30000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou ArnUser=acs:ram::1298452580000000:role/role-test --arn RoleType=service RoleArn=acs:ram:xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CommitContainer

parameters.help_en: The ECI instance for which you want to create a CommitContainer task
parameters.name: container_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the container that you want to use to create the image
parameters.help_zh: 要制作镜像的容器的名称
parameters.name: container_name

fields.help_en:
The address of the ACR image repository.
For security reasons, you can push images only to ACR.
fields.help_zh:
ACR镜像仓库地址。    
出于安全考虑，目前仅支持将镜像推送（Push）至ACR
fields.name: repository

fields.help_en: The tag of the image. If you leave this parameter empty, the tag is not modified
fields.help_zh: 镜像标签。默认为空，代表不修改标签
fields.name: tag

fields.help_en: Specifies the author of the image
fields.name: author

parameters.help_en: The information about the container image
parameters.name: image

fields.help_en: The ID of the ACR Enterprise Edition instance
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The region where the ACR Enterprise Edition instance is located
fields.help_zh: ACR企业版实例所属的地域
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en: In a cross-account authorization scenario, this is the Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role of the user who is granted permissions
fields.help_zh: 跨账号授权场景下，使用者（被授权者）的RAM角色ARN
fields.name: arn_service

fields.help_en: In a cross-account authorization scenario, this is the ARN of the RAM role of the user who grants the permissions
fields.help_zh: 跨账号授权场景下，授权者的RAM角色ARN
fields.name: arn_user

parameters.help_en:
The access credential configurations for the ACR Enterprise Edition instance.

You do not need to configure this parameter if you use an ACR Personal Edition instance. You must configure this parameter if you use an ACR Enterprise Edition instance
parameters.help_zh:
ACR企业版实例的访问凭证配置信息。    

使用ACR个人版实例时无需配置该参数；使用ACR企业版实例时必须配置该参数
parameters.name: acr_registry_info

fields.help_en: The ARN of the authorization role
fields.name: role_arn

fields.help_en: The authorization type. Set the value to service to use a RAM role for authorization
fields.help_zh: 授权类型。可配置为service，表示使用RAM角色进行授权
fields.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ARN information required for authorization
parameters.name: arn
